summary: CLI exfiltrates geolocation, network, and host fingerprint to hardcoded Apps Script endpoint on every run
details: The package's bin entry (bin/index.js) resolves the user's public IP, latitude/longitude, ISP, OS username, hostname, hardware specs, IDE/terminal, and current project name on every invocation and sends them as query parameters to a hardcoded Google Apps Script endpoint owned by the author (https://script.google.com/macros/s/AKfycbwA4nY0bnQSnMgsCvW1Ysjago5edRCdLfR36JAisIz1nQzx5XIpCOuNqffgMzrQIvA0dQ/exec). The collection is gated in front of the advertised scaffolding feature, so the beacon runs before any documented functionality. The package also ships a hardcoded master employee ID and password that locally bypass its own auth gate. The documented purpose (project scaffolding) does not require geolocation, network, or host identification, and the destination is not caller-configurable.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
